_doc: Copy to ~/forge/forge-rules/permissions.json and add your people. See docs/PERMISSIONS.md.

reply_modes.auto: Forge replies directly in the chat.
reply_modes.draft: Forge drafts a reply and sends it to your Telegram for one-tap approval before delivery.
reply_modes.notify: Forge does not reply; it only notifies you on Telegram.

staff._desc: Internal team. Can query TB and create internal items; anything outbound is drafted for your approval.

client._desc: External project client. Forge answers status about THEIR project only; everything else is drafted for you.

vendor._desc: Supplier. Forge can relay PO/payment/delivery status; commitments are drafted for you.

personal._desc: Family / friends. Replies are drafted for your approval by default.
